summary: The second remediation closes the prior frozen-source substitution, deep-replay FAIL/zero-stat/missing-digest, recorded-command, cache/resource/runtime/support, and coordinated-feature counterexamples. The exact 15-test lane passes, the sanitized recorded command returns ok=true, all 28 tracked mutations are killed, and nominal outputs are byte-current. One fresh P2 scientific-artifact provenance false green remains: coordinated resealing of the frozen PR-152 card hash and raw-root entries in both the feature card and deep-replay input_hashes is accepted with no validator errors. The independently reconstructed source authority and cache identity remain correct, so this review found no scientific-data substitution or claim promotion, but the mandatory input-hash provenance list is not fail-closed and PR-177 is not closeout-ready.
